name: Rocket City Radio Controllers (RCRC)
briefDescription: Large, family-friendly AMA-chartered RC airplane club in Huntsville with paved runway and clubhouse.
keyFeatures: 50' x 600' runway, covered pits, clubhouse, events (fun flies, Toys for Tots), training

name: North Alabama Radio Control Association (NARCA)
briefDescription: AMA-chartered club flying from Epps Airpark (private GA airport) serving Harvest/Huntsville area.
keyFeatures: Field at Epps Airpark, FRIA (RemoteID) compliance, events and newsletters

name: Alabaster Radio Control Association (ARCA)
briefDescription: AMA-chartered club in Shelby County flying at Limestone Park; community outreach and youth programs.
keyFeatures: Grass field in Limestone Park, training, monthly events, community education

name: DeKalb R/C Flyers (McCurdy Field)
briefDescription: DeKalb County club with a recently developed field (McCurdy Field) at Valley Head.
keyFeatures: New field (McCurdy Field), welcomes guests, regular meetings and grand opening events

name: Azalea City Model Aeronautics
briefDescription: Mobile-area AMA chartered club flying at Irvington Field (650+ ft paved runway).
keyFeatures: Paved runway (~650 ft), warbird and giant-scale events (e.g., Warbirds Over Mobile)

address.street: Crawley Lane / Irvington Field (Old Irvington Landfill area / Half Mile Rd)

name: Birmingham RC Association
briefDescription: Long-standing AMA club north of Birmingham with a paved runway and extensive facilities.
keyFeatures: 502' paved runway, sheltered electrified pits, annual 'Bigfoot' fun-fly & community events

name: Wiregrass Radio Control Club (Liberty Landing)
briefDescription: Wiregrass area RC club serving southeast AL with a rural flying field (Liberty Landing).
keyFeatures: Rural grass field, community outreach, events and training; membership/AMA required

name: Sand Mountain Flyers
briefDescription: Regional club on Sand Mountain serving the Albertville / Boaz area.
keyFeatures: Local community club, grass field, monthly events

name: Huntsville Heli Flyers
briefDescription: Helicopter-focused club based in Huntsville (runs annual heli fun-fly).
keyFeatures: Helicopter specialty club, annual Steve Helms fun-fly, located on A&M grounds / Chase Rd area

name: Auburn Planesmen R/C Flying Club
briefDescription: AMA-chartered club serving Auburn / Opelika with a private grass airfield (intersection CR24 & CR22).
location: Auburn / Lee County (field in Macon County), AL
keyFeatures: Private grass airstrip, instructor training, family-friendly membership

address.street: Gate at 2275 County Road 24 (near intersection with County Road 22)

name: Decatur Model Airplane Club (DMAC)
briefDescription: One of the oldest U.S. model airplane clubs (est. 1937), AMA-chartered, multiple flying sites near Decatur.
keyFeatures: Historic club, multiple fields, swap meets, club events

name: West Alabama Aero Modelers (WAAM)
briefDescription: Tuscaloosa-area AMA chartered club with a long history, regular events and training.
keyFeatures: IMAA & AMA membership, events (warbirds/3D/heli), on-site facilities and membership programs

address.street: Field access off Fosters Ferry Road / (listed historically at 6655 Watermelon Rd)

name: Talladega Radio Control Club
briefDescription: Local RC club in the Talladega area flying at Henderson Lake Road field (Munford area).
keyFeatures: Monthly fly-ins, welcoming pilots of all types, open flying days

name: Magic City Flyers
briefDescription: Independent club serving the Birmingham area with a mix of fixed-wing and rotary aircraft.
keyFeatures: Grass field, monthly fun-flys, community outreach, instruction for beginners

name: Central Alabama Modelers (CAM)
briefDescription: Independent RC club near Montgomery for both electric and gas-powered aircraft.
keyFeatures: Large open field, community events, beginner training, annual fly-ins

name: Tuscaloosa RC Flyers
briefDescription: Independent club flying in Tuscaloosa county with a dedicated grass runway.
keyFeatures: Grass runway, open membership, beginner instruction, family-oriented events

name: Gulf Coast RC Flyers
briefDescription: Independent RC club near Mobile focusing on electric and sport planes.
keyFeatures: Grass field, local competitions, family-friendly, seasonal events

name: Shoals RC Club
briefDescription: Independent club in northwest Alabama around Florence and Muscle Shoals area.
keyFeatures: Grass runway, family-oriented, monthly club events, training sessions

name: South Alabama RC Modelers
briefDescription: AMA-chartered club in Foley, AL, offering a welcoming environment for all skill levels.
keyFeatures: Multiple flying fields, community events, training programs

name: Central Alabama Sports Flyers
briefDescription: AMA-chartered club in Clanton, AL, known for its large flying field and family-friendly atmosphere.
keyFeatures: 1000 ft runway, pavilions with power outlets, full bathrooms and showers
